title: Strip the footnote-anchor space from the Norway compare lane

sections: F-06 — Footnote-anchor whitespace in published text

objective: Extend the Norway compare-only text normalization so the space a stripped footnote anchor leaves before a closing parenthesis stops registering as replay-vs-consolidation divergence, without touching replay materialization.
preflightChecks: src/lawvm/norway/verify.py defines _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES as a tuple of ComparisonNormalizationRule entries.
normalize_no_comparison_text in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py applies _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES to its input.
The punctuation-spacing character class in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py does not cover a closing parenthesis.
src/lawvm/norway/verify.py already normalizes a space after an opening parenthesis.
Both compared bodies in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py pass through _normalize_no_compare_tree before divergence detection.
src/lawvm/tools/spec_ledger_no_catalog.py carries a _NO_RULE_SPECS entry for every existing no_compare_ rule id.
no-divergence for no/lov/2018-06-15-44 at as-of 2026-07-10 shows a space before the closing parenthesis after 910/2014.
requirements: Add one typed ComparisonNormalizationRule entry, rule_class presentation_cleanup, following the naming family of the existing no_compare_* rules.
The rule removes the space a stripped footnote anchor leaves before a closing parenthesis, mirroring the existing opening-parenthesis rule.
Add the matching _NO_RULE_SPECS believed-spec entry in src/lawvm/tools/spec_ledger_no_catalog.py, beside no_compare_open_paren_spacing, in the siblings behavioral voice.
Cover the real corpus shape in tests: 910/2014 ) normalizes to 910/2014).

Add a boundedness test whose two inputs differ ONLY inside the region this rule rewrites, and assert they still normalize to different strings. A pair differing elsewhere is vacuous: it passes identically without the rule.
Normalization stays in the compare-only lane; replay materialization and adjudication behavior are unchanged.
invariants: Existing _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES entries keep their names, order relative to each other, and behavior.
Both compared trees receive identical normalization.
The rule erases presentation residue only; it must not make two texts that differ in operative wording compare equal.
No consolidated-text authority widens over replay.
Every NO rule id emitted under src/lawvm/norway/ has a _NO_RULE_SPECS entry.
The norway and tools_cli_debug shards pass.
exclusions: The trailing footnote-marker digit (findings ledger F-05): a spike measured both candidate rules masking real cross-reference differences, so it is out of scope here and reclassified in the ledger.
The akkord/rekonstruksjonsforhandling mismatch in no/lov/2019-12-20-109 (F-03) is a commencement question, not compare noise.
Findings-ledger and progress-ledger updates: those are the human apply step.
stopConditions: If the parenthesis rule cannot be written without also altering text where the space is not footnote residue, abort and record the counter-example.
reviewFocus: A compare-lane rule runs on BOTH sides, so a rule that over-matches makes genuinely different texts compare equal and MASKS real divergence. Verify the boundedness test's two inputs differ ONLY inside the region the rule rewrites; a pair differing elsewhere proves nothing and passes without the rule.
Verify symmetry: confirm a replay-side text carrying the same shape is normalized identically rather than creating a new mismatch.
A new no_* rule id is discovered by AST scan and must be cataloged; confirm the _NO_RULE_SPECS entry exists and reads in the siblings voice.

targeted.command: uv run ruff check src/lawvm/norway/verify.py tests/test_norway_verify.py src/lawvm/tools/spec_ledger_no_catalog.py --no-fix
uv run ty check src/lawvm/norway/verify.py tests/test_norway_verify.py src/lawvm/tools/spec_ledger_no_catalog.py

instructions: uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2018-06-15-44 --as-of 2026-07-10 — the law reports zero divergences.
uv run lawvm no-verify-scan --limit 50 --as-of 2026-07-10 — consistent count rises from 11 to 12 (no/lov/2018-06-15-44 becomes consistent) and no law that was consistent before is divergent now.
uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2019-12-20-109 --as-of 2026-07-10 — still 2 divergences (F-03 akkord, F-05 footnote digit): this batch does not claim either.
Update notes/NORWAY_VERIFY_FINDINGS_LEDGER.md: F-06 to fixed with the apply commit, scoreboard row, changelog line.
